raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since 2026-01-17 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy emits America/Chicago local time. The v2 rows are therefore shifted +6h: an evening Chicago transaction lands on the next UTC date at 00:00-04:42, which explains the 36 early-morning rows on 2026-01-19. A v2 row at 12:11 UTC is 06:11 Chicago, which fits the 06:00 opening seen in legacy data. The fix converts v2 timestamps to Chicago local time before deriving txn_date. January is CST (UTC-6) with no DST change, so a fixed 6-hour subtraction is safe.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.88,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
